snippet.title: Hunting Simulator 3 | Gameplay Reveal
snippet.description:
Wishlist Hunting Simulator 3 now on Steam, PlayStation 5 and Xbox X|S: https://linktr.ee/huntingsim

Dive into a suspended moment, where every detail matters and nature sets its own rules.

In this Hunting Simulator 3 Gameplay Reveal, discover an immersive hunting experience where preparation, patience, and precision are essential. Every element counts, from choosing your equipment to your ability to read the environment. Move carefully, observe, listen… and let yourself be guided by the rhythm of the wild.
Accompanied by your loyal companion, explore living environments, adapt to changing conditions, and feel the full tension of a hunt where every decision can make the difference.

When the moment comes, will you be ready to make it count?

Register now to have a chance to join the Playstest: https://my.nacongaming.com/playtests 
Follow us: https://linktr.ee/huntingsim
